verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator with Git delivery, so auto-opening a pull request on task completion is a fair axis to judge. The evidence describes a different delivery model: `finish` queues a committed candidate and `merge land` composes it directly into a protected target using expected-old ref protection. Nothing in the pack shows it creating a GitHub or other pull request when a task completes; the GitHub integration only returns responses to issue threads.
